context_slots: Occupied VDisk slots / expected number of slots on the PDisk.
context_log-size: Space used by the PDisk log / total log capacity.
context_system-size: PDisk space reserved for system data.
context_state-initial: The PDisk actor is starting and has not yet begun reading disk metadata
context_initial-format-read: The PDisk is reading and validating its format record
context_initial-sys-log-read: The PDisk is reading its system log during startup
context_initial-common-log-read: The PDisk is reading VDisk common log during startup
context_open-file-error: The PDisk could not open its backing device
context_device-io-error: The PDisk encountered a fatal physical device I/O error
context_stopped: The PDisk was explicitly stopped by a control request
context_initial-format-read-error: The format record could not be read or validated
context_initial-sys-log-read-error: The system log could not be read
context_initial-sys-log-parse-error: The system log was read but could not be parsed
context_common-logger-init-error: The PDisk failed to initialize the VDisk common log writer
context_initial-common-log-read-error: VDisk common log could not be read
context_initial-common-log-parse-error: VDisk common log was read but could not be parsed
context_chunk-quota-error: The PDisk failed to calculate or initialize chunk quotas
context_inactive: New groups are not created over this drive, but existing ones continue to work as expected
context_to-be-removed: Same as INACTIVE, but drive is counted in fault model as not working
context_faulty: Drive is expected to become BROKEN soon, new groups are not created, old groups are asynchronously moved out from this drive
context_broken: Drive is not working, groups are automatically moved out of this drive upon reception of this status
context_decommit-none: The PDisk is not being decommissioned
context_decommit-pending: Decommissioning is planned; allocation of new VDisks is blocked, existing VDisks are not moved
context_decommit-rejected: The PDisk is operational but cannot receive VDisks moved from the other decommitted PDisks
context_decommit-imminent: Active phase of decommissioning, existing VDisks are moved from the PDisk asynchronously
context_maintenance-none: There is no active maintenance request for this PDisk
context_maintenance-unset: No maintenance status has been explicitly provided
context_maintenance-no-new-vdisks: Allocation of new VDisks is blocked, existing VDisks are not moved
context_maintenance-long-term: Device is requested for a long-term maintenance, existing VDisks are moved from the PDisk asynchronously
